visual.general_description: Multichannel EEG tracing screenshot with 26 numbered rows, including two bottom rows with brief sharp deflections.
visual.detailed_description: Screenshot of a multichannel EEG tracing: 26 numbered horizontal traces stacked in rows with a channel-label column at the left, light yellow vertical gridlines across the page and a bottom marker row labelled "M". Rows 1-4 and 11-14 are drawn in blue, rows 6-9 and 16-19 in dark red, rows 21-22 in green, rows 23-24 in reddish-brown, row 25 in purple and row 26 in black. Rows 5, 10, 15 and 20 are flat grey lines labelled "0V-0V". Channel labels are small and low resolution; they appear to read Fp1-F3, F3-C3, C3-P3, P3-O1 (rows 1-4), Fp2-F4, F4-C4, C4-P4, P4-O2 (rows 6-9), Fp1-F7, F7-T3, T3-T5, T5-O1 (rows 11-14), Fp2-F8, F8-T4, T4-T6, T6-O2 (rows 16-19), Fz-Cz, Cz-Pz (rows 21-22), then two italic labels for rows 23-24 and "X1-0V" and "T1-0V" for rows 25-26. A small sensitivity label sits beside each row. Small blue text labels sit over rows 25 and 26. The scalp-channel rows show continuous irregular low-amplitude traces, with some lower-frequency, larger-amplitude deflections in a few rows. Rows 25 and 26 are near-flat lines interrupted by five brief sharp deflections that occur at matching positions in both rows. A square-wave marker trace runs along the bottom row. No printed time axis, calibration scale beyond the small row labels, patient name, date or other identifier is legible.

visual.general_description: Colour schematic of the U1-SnRNP complex with labelled RNP A, RNP 70kDa, RNP C, U1 RNA and Sm protein complex.
visual.detailed_description: Colour schematic diagram of the U1-SnRNP complex on a white background. A light-blue circle labelled "RNP A" sits on a vertical double-line stem-loop at the top; a hollow loop in that stem carries the label "U1 RNA". An orange circle labelled "RNP 70kDa" sits at the left end of a horizontal double line, with a green oval labelled "RNP C" just below it, and a "5'" label beside a short line near the left. In the lower centre a ring of seven purple ovals is labelled with the letters B, D1, D2, E, F, G and D3, with a bracket below it labelled "Sm protein complex". A smaller hairpin with two hollow loops stands at the right with a "3'" label near its base. A long bracket along the bottom is labelled "U1-SnRNP". There are no arrows, axes or patient data.
